Even the first case seems to hang, and no output was flushed? I used `-u` so output should be unbuffered... but the heredoc script's output goes through `tail -25`, which buffers. Hmm, but `timeout 160` should have killed it at 160s and tail would print. The tool call has a 180s limit; the command exceeded it. So the whole thing (16 cases × up to 25s = 400s) exceeded the limit.

Let me test just the first case with a hard timeout.

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && timeout 60 python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -6
import json, sys, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import adv
cases=adv.fam()
name, r = cases[0]
data=(json.dumps(r)+"\n").encode()
t0=time.time()
try:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
    print(name, "%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), p.stdout.decode()[:120])
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
    print(name, "TIMEOUT", e.stdout[:100] if e.stdout else None)
PYEOF
